cards.back: The branch of mathematics dealing with shapes, sizes, and properties of space
A location in space with no size or dimension
A straight path that extends infinitely in both directions
A part of a line with two endpoints
A part of a line that starts at a point and extends infinitely in one direction
The figure formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint
An angle that measures exactly 90 degrees
An angle that measures less than 90 degrees
An angle that measures more than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees
An angle that measures exactly 180 degrees
A polygon with three sides and three angles
A polygon with four sides and four angles
A set of points equidistant from a center point
The distance from the center of a circle to any point on the circle
The distance across a circle through its center
The distance around a circle
The amount of space inside a two-dimensional figure
The distance around a two-dimensional figure
The amount of space inside a three-dimensional figure
The total area of all faces of a three-dimensional figure
